product_metadata.title: Elite Cuisine EG-1220G 12-Inch Non-Stick Electric Skillet with Glass Lid, Black
features: Removable and adjustable 450° F temperature control with temperature-ready light that keeps you apprised of the skillet's heating status
Extra-large 12" x 12" non-stick cooking surface with high side walls
Plastic cool-touch handles enable simple portability
Cool-touch handles and tempered glass lid
description: The Elite Gourmet 12” Electric Skillet fries, grills, roasts, stews, and more making it easy to cook your favorite food in just one appliance. With its smooth 12” x 12” non-stick cooking surface, clean-up is easy. With its quick and even heating up to 450° F with temperature control and temperature-ready light. Use it to cook anything from eggs and sausage, to hamburgers and steaks, even sauté your favorite vegetables. Features a tempered glass lid and cool-touch handles for safe and easy serving. Cook and serve directly out of the skillet! Designed for both style and function, the heavy durable cast aluminum base prevents any warping from high temperatures and the high side walls prevent food spillage. Serve directly out of skillet with thermostat removed!
